nodes.summary: Every injective proper vertex coloring of a simple graph is centered: any vertex of a set whose induced subgraph is connected is a center of that set.
nodes.title: Injective colorings are centered

nodes.summary: A proper vertex coloring $\varphi$ of a simple graph $G$ is centered if, for every set $s$ of vertices of $G$ whose induced subgraph is connected, some vertex is a $\varphi$-center of $s$.
nodes.title: Centered coloring

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a proper vertex coloring of a simple graph $G$, let $s$ be a set of vertices of $G$ and let $v$ be a vertex of $G$. Then $v$ is a $\varphi$-center of $s$ if and only if $v \in s$ and there is exactly one vertex $u \in s$ with $\varphi(u) = \varphi(v)$.
nodes.title: Centers via unique existence

nodes.summary: For every proper vertex coloring $\varphi$ of a simple graph $G$ and every vertex $v$ of $G$, $v$ is a $\varphi$-center of $\{v\}$.
nodes.title: A vertex is a center of its singleton

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a proper vertex coloring of a simple graph $G$, let $s$ be a set of vertices of $G$ and let $v$ be a vertex of $G$. Then $v$ is a $\varphi$-center of $s$ if $v \in s$ and no other vertex of $s$ has the color $\varphi(v)$.
nodes.title: Center of a vertex set under a coloring

nodes.summary: For every simple graph $G$ with vertex set $V$, the proper vertex coloring of $G$ by $V$ that gives each vertex itself as its color is centered.
nodes.title: The identity coloring is centered

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
